title: Al cutoff at 50% crystal and 90% peer crossing

execution.note: Local physical audit; no training or simulation jobs changed.

evidence.note: 150 historical ancestors; 21 complete dense descendants at 520 K, completion-limited.

interpretation.note: Individual confirmed-halfway stopping saves about 47% of historical measurement duration; delayed runs are censored. 400 K population 90th-percentile time is not observed by 600 ps.

analyses.title: Al cutoff at 50% crystal and 90% peer crossing
analyses.context: Frozen counterfactual individual halfway stops and population peer caps; dense coverage is 21 completed 520 K descendants. The separately authorized queue version applies this target to 128 unstarted trajectories without changing the numerical audit or running simulations.

population.scope: Descriptive audit; no fitted models/selectors; descendants grouped by ancestry.

selection.rule: Declared thresholds; no optimization or promotion.
